identity.name: PINDER-S
identity.primary_scale: All 93 PINDER-S cases with both primary apo monomers; parent benchmark has 250 cases

found_basis: Public source supplies PINDER evaluator, FroDock adapter, documented commands, and accessible required input inventory. Found does not assert successful reproduction.

outcome_definition.scientific: Recovery of experimentally observed protein-protein interfaces from paired apo inputs. Report top-ranked pose and best of fixed candidate set separately.
limitations: AAV inputs are separated bound components for redocking, not independent apo structures.
Docking accuracy alone cannot establish BBB transcytosis, affinity, or therapeutic relevance.
FroDock mirror identity with original study software and SOAP scores remains unverified. Published-value agreement cannot establish byte identity.

citations.title: PINDER: The Protein INteraction Dataset and Evaluation Resource
DockQ: A Quality Measure for Protein-Protein Docking Models

source_licences_and_intended_use.item: PINDER source including evaluator and adapter
PINDER 2024-02 structural inputs, index, metadata and mappings
source_licences_and_intended_use.reason: Repository Apache-2.0 licence found; explicit coverage of separately hosted derived dataset and annotations not established. Original PDB coordinate CC0 terms do not establish terms for every derived input.

source_licences_and_intended_use.item: FroDock mirror software and required bin/soap.bin
source_licences_and_intended_use.reason: Original distribution route returns HTTP 404. Mirror README and archive member names inspected; no package licence or explicit scoring-input coverage established. Owner authorizes local experiment with mirror but that does not establish upstream rights.

stock_cuda_image.reason: Exact stock image tag, OS libraries and CPU/RAM inventory not supplied; no build or workload run. CPU/MPI FroDock has no demonstrated CUDA requirement, but source adapter and build issues require reproduction.
requirements: FFTW single precision and MPI libraries
Python with PINDER evaluation and methods dependencies
source_inspection_issues: Adapter concatenates binary directory Path with executable filename without slash.
Adapter changes to temporary directory without copying receptor and ligand there.
Adapter calls shutil.copy on literal *.pdb path.
Runner uses pandas.from_csv and inconsistent setup CSV locations.
Dockerfile copies archive to /workspace but extracts from /root/workspace; final PATH /app/frodock/bin differs from /workspace/frodock/bin.
stock_cuda_image.compatibility_conclusion: Unknown pending correction and reproduction; these are software defects, not evidence of stock CUDA hardware incompatibility.

size.reason: Exact required subset residency and peak FFT/MPI working set not measured. Inventory byte totals include optional auxiliaries, duplicate representations and compressed archives; cannot equate their sum to data plus peak working set.

scoring.interface: pinder_eval CLI; ranked two-chain R/L PDB models; metrics and leaderboard CSV
scoring.reason: No published numerical reproduction tolerance located; case counts are references only.
scoring.missing_predictions: Published harness uses iRMS=100, LRMS=100, Fnat=0, DockQ=0 and CAPRI=Incorrect; retain denominator.

repeatability.case_selection: All 93 paired-primary-apo PINDER-S cases, frozen from pinned index; no case-scale search.
repeatability.candidate_count_basis: Intake preregistration choice for fixed best-of-N comparison, not a published baseline result or configuration.
repeatability.reason: Brief requires independent random seeds but supplies none; published FroDock adapter exposes no seed parameter. Do not claim seeded stochastic repeats until method supports it.

search_candidates.name: PINDER-S
search_candidates.reason: Explicit benchmark in brief; no substitute searched or selected.

evidence_limits: Material retrieval and hashes are owner-provided evidence from 2026-10-31 inventory. This intake fetched source and mirror metadata but did not re-download every structural input or run correctness checks.
